title: A living custom and hope for simplicity

captions.energy: Adding care without a shared measure
captions.emotions: Hoping for a freer life together

meaning: A household custom can sustain hope for warmth when care does not acquire requirements that move simplicity and rest further away.
text: A sense of shared home may grow through repeated actions: a familiar breakfast, a way of greeting evening and small domestic customs. The Hierophant in the physical position of Muladhara describes sustaining this recognisable form. The Empress in energy tests your footing through continually adding care, as though comfort remains insufficient. The Star in emotions hopes for a bright, free life together. Hope preserves the value of home, yet may recede when reaching it demands ever more preparation, decoration and unnoticed daily work.

For example, you enjoy quiet tea by the window, but baking, a special tablecloth and a completely tidy room gradually become necessary beforehand. Long-awaited quiet begins later. **Hope for comfort need not continually complicate the way towards it.** Tea together keeps its meaning without added conditions. A familiar custom can offer the hoped-for life now, with care supporting it instead of endlessly preparing what should finally become a pleasant evening.

The difficulty is considering the simple version poor or insufficiently attentive. Ideal domestic peace remains a hope while real evenings fill with maintaining its conditions. You protect a beautiful dream and rarely meet it in an ordinary day. Traditions help more when their meaning survives without compulsorily increasing tasks, objects or demands on your own diligence. What you value can then remain close enough to enjoy.
